description: Add XML and YAML parsing support for CycloneDX and SPDX SBOM formats, including updated format detection logic
steps: Step 1: Update detectFormat() in internal/sbom/sbom.go to handle XML and YAML input in addition to JSON. Detection strategy: (a) if bytes start with '<?xml' or '<' after trimming whitespace, treat as XML and probe for CycloneDX namespace or SPDX element names; (b) try YAML unmarshaling into a probe struct checking bomFormat and spdxVersion fields; (c) fall back to existing JSON detection.

Step 2: Add XML struct tags to the existing CycloneDX struct types in internal/sbom/cyclonedx.go (or create a separate internal struct set for XML). The CycloneDX XML format uses namespace http://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom/1.6 (or 1.5/1.7). The root element is <bom> with <components> containing <component> elements. Each <component> has child elements: <name>, <version>, <purl>, <group>, <scope>, and <properties> containing <property name=... value=...>. Add a parseCycloneDXXML(data []byte) function.

Step 3: Add YAML parsing for CycloneDX in internal/sbom/cyclonedx.go. CycloneDX YAML uses the same structure as JSON but with YAML syntax. The existing JSON struct tags map 1:1 with YAML field names. Add yaml struct tags to the cycloneDX types and add parseCycloneDXYAML(data []byte) function using gopkg.in/yaml.v3.

Step 4: Add XML parsing for SPDX in internal/sbom/spdx.go. SPDX 2.3 XML (RDF/XML) uses elements like <SpdxDocument> with <packages> containing <Package> elements. Each Package has <name>, <versionInfo>, and <externalRef> elements containing <referenceCategory>, <referenceType>, <referenceLocator>. Add parseSPDXXML(data []byte) function. Note: SPDX XML is relatively rare but the element names mirror the JSON field names in a straightforward XML mapping.

Step 5: Add YAML parsing for SPDX in internal/sbom/spdx.go. SPDX YAML has the same structure as SPDX JSON with YAML syntax (spdxVersion, packages array with externalRefs). Add yaml struct tags and parseSPDXYAML(data []byte) function.
Step 6: Update the Parse() function and the internal dispatch in internal/sbom/sbom.go to route XML/YAML data to the appropriate parser functions based on the detected encoding format.

Step 7: Add comprehensive tests in internal/sbom/cyclonedx_test.go for CycloneDX XML and YAML parsing. Create inline mock data based on CycloneDX official schema structure. Test cases: basic parsing with multiple components, dev dependency detection (scope element + property element), skip components without purl, empty components list.

Step 8: Add comprehensive tests in internal/sbom/spdx_test.go for SPDX XML and YAML parsing. Create inline mock data based on SPDX 2.3 official schema structure. Test cases: basic parsing with multiple packages, skip packages without purl external ref, IsDev always false.
Step 9: Add tests for the updated detectFormat() to cover XML and YAML inputs in addition to existing JSON tests.
Step 10: Update the package doc comment in internal/sbom/sbom.go to reflect the newly supported formats (CycloneDX XML/YAML, SPDX XML/YAML).
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... succeeds with no errors
go test ./internal/sbom/... -v -count=1 passes all tests (existing and new)
CycloneDX XML input is correctly parsed to produce the same Component output as equivalent JSON
CycloneDX YAML input is correctly parsed to produce the same Component output as equivalent JSON
SPDX XML input is correctly parsed to produce the same Component output as equivalent JSON
SPDX YAML input is correctly parsed to produce the same Component output as equivalent JSON
detectFormat() correctly identifies all 6 input types: CycloneDX JSON/XML/YAML and SPDX JSON/XML/YAML
Components without purl are still skipped in all format variants
Dev dependency detection still works correctly for CycloneDX XML/YAML variants
All test mock data is inline in test files, not in external testdata files
findings: All 26 tests pass. Build succeeds cleanly. gopkg.in/yaml.v3 was already in go.mod, encoding/xml is stdlib. detectFormat now returns a *detectedFormat struct (format + encoding) instead of a plain string, and the TestDetectFormat test was updated accordingly to check got.format instead of got directly. Review follow-up: rewrote detectXMLFormat to use xml.NewDecoder (issue #1), added 11 malformed-input test cases (issue #3), documented SPDX XML nesting assumption (issue #2), documented CycloneDX bom-ref version scope (issue #4), and added JSON-before-YAML ordering comment. Total test count: 38 (all pass).
